description: Returns historical company fundamentals (revenue, net income, margins, assets, liabilities, debt ratios, free cash flow) by fiscal year or quarter, derived from SEC filings. Requires EDGAR Alert PRO plan or higher. Use edgaralert_get_company_profile first if you just need the latest snapshot rather than multi-year history.

period.description: FY for annual fundamentals, Q for quarterly.

tickerOrCik.description: Stock ticker (e.g. MSFT) or SEC CIK number.

years.description: Number of years of history to return.

name: edgaralert_get_company_fundamentals
title: Get company fundamentals history
